title: B Reviewer Output — workflow JS sub-task B-2 surface
description: Validates the JSON that workflow JS agents (phase1-requirements.js, etc.) parse from the B sub-agent round. Required by review_schema_validator.validate_b_output() and enforced by auto_fix.dispatch() to distinguish real_invention from over_interpretation gaps.

review_status.description: APPROVE = gaps exist but tolerable; REJECT = blocking failure; CANCELLED = framework-level error (schema violation, dispatch failure).

confidence.description: Reviewer self-rated confidence. Optional in workflow JS surface but used by review_schema_validator for synthesis.

reason.description: Workflow-JS surface uses 'reason' instead of 'summary' for B-2 concise rationale. Either-or accepted. Must be >=100 chars when present (absorbs the phase6-quality.js hand-rolled length check).

citations.description: Optional list of file:line references supporting the review.

docs_embedded.description: Optional list of docs the reviewer cross-checked.

gaps.description: Structured gap list. Each gap MUST carry evidence_type so the framework can distinguish real invention (escalates to high) from over-interpretation (auto-fix path) from methodology artifacts (silent low).

severity.description: high = real_invention (real new requirement); medium = over_interpretation (ambiguous canonical, missing DERIVED tag / NFR-99); low = methodology_artifact (sha256, regex tables, 'Methodology pin').

evidence_type.description: Required classifier. Tells framework which fix strategy to dispatch. real_invention → HR-12 escalate; over_interpretation → fix_over_interpretation_gap; methodology_artifact → silent low.

canonical_ref.description: Pointer to SPEC.md / canonical source (file:line, section ID, or FR/NFR ID). Empty string allowed only when evidence_type=methodology_artifact.

fr_id.description: Optional: which FR this gap belongs to. Null allowed when gap is project-wide.
